obligations.title: Termination for convenience notice
obligations.detail: Either party must provide 90 days prior written notice.
obligations.dueRule: 90 days before intended termination effective date
obligations.calendarHint: Set reminder 95 days before earliest contemplated exit window.

obligations.title: Invoice payment terms
obligations.detail: Net 30 from invoice date; late fees 1.5% per month on overdue amounts.

obligations.title: Monthly uptime commitment
obligations.detail: 99.5% monthly uptime excluding scheduled maintenance with 5 business days' notice.
obligations.dueRule: Ongoing; credits claimed within 30 days of month-end
obligations.calendarHint: Review SLA credit eligibility on the 5th business day of each month.

obligations.title: New subprocessor objection window
obligations.detail: 30 days' notice before adding subprocessors; Controller may object on reasonable grounds.
obligations.calendarHint: Subscribe to vendor subprocessor change feed.

obligations.title: Auto-renewal opt-out
obligations.detail: Order Form renews for successive one-year terms unless either party provides 60 days' notice before term end.
obligations.dueRule: Notice no later than 60 days before current term end (2027-03-31)
